headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Darby Allin vs. Samoa Joe battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.66 ? a match that delivered ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. Allin attacked Joe with a skateboard and a ladder before the bell even rang, then capped a hometown title win with back-to-back Coffin Drops as Sting embraced him in an emotional moment.
Flash back to 2025, when Brian Cage vs. Dante Martin vs. Komander vs. The Beast Mortos fought it out in a High Speed Collision match on Collision, rated 6.22.

Looking back to 2023, when The Acclaimed vs. Jarrett & Lethal fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.56. For Jarrett & Lethal, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. It was the 50th time the AEW World Tag Team Titles had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. The Acclaimed was chasing gold for the 10th time. In a No Holds Barred match, The Acclaimed fought off Jeff Jarrett and Jay Lethal ? with Billy Gunn getting ejected at ringside ? to retain the AEW World Tag Team Championship.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.37.
Turning the clock back to 2025: Big Bill was back in action after just under 2 months away, appearing on Collision.
It was 2025 when Deonna Purrazzo returned to the fold after 4 months away, appearing on Collision.
